entry.title: Ken Griffin Says AI Is 'Almost Certainly' in a Bubble—And Compares GPUs to Airline Seats
entry.summary: Citadel's founder says investors are almost certainly in an AI bubble, warns a chip glut could crash prices like empty airline seats, yet expects the survivors to lead for decades.

entry.title: Nvidia Unveils Its Full-Stack Blueprint to Contain and Monitor AI Agents
entry.summary: Nvidia's OpenShell Reference Architecture pairs a software sandbox on Vera CPUs with Sentry monitoring on BlueField-4 chips, aiming to let companies run autonomous agents while enforcing limits agents cannot reach.

entry.title: Who Found the PHP Bug That Made Governments Unplug Their Websites? ChatGPT, Of Course
entry.summary: OpenAI says its models found PHP2Shell and led a two-month coalition to fix it. It's the same AI that broke into Hugging Face and an Australian government portal this year.

entry.title: How a SpaceX and Tesla Merger Would Reshape Musk’s AI Empire
entry.summary: Both boards are now studying a tie-up that would put Grok, X, Starlink, orbital data centers, a chip megafactory and Optimus robots under one roof—and under one man's control.

entry.title: Bitcoin Hits Weekly High as Crypto Market Rebounds
entry.summary: Bitcoin is back near $84,500 as XRP and Zcash lead a broad crypto rebound from October's slide, putting "Uptober" back on the table.

entry.title: Dogecoin Gets a Dedicated Company to Build Out Its Ecosystem

entry.title: Musk’s SpaceX-Tesla Merger Would Create a Bitcoin Treasury Behemoth

entry.title: What Is a Bitcoin-Backed Loan? Borrowing Against BTC Explained

entry.summary: Two critical bugs in PHP, the language running most of the web, let strangers take over servers without a password. The patch is out, attacks started early, and governments pulled the plug.

entry.title: Solana Alpenglow Goes Live in 'Most Ambitious' Upgrade Since Ethereum's Merge
entry.summary: The new consensus protocol retires TowerBFT, which had run Solana since its 2020 launch, after a handoff on the live network.

entry.summary: The bank has Bitcoin outperforming all asset classes spanning real estate, stocks and gold over the next 10-15 years.
